I've saved the Q3 answers to `/work/answer.json`. Run with the same method on Q2, my code reproduces all 10 of your reference values exactly.

The definitions only matched the Q2 reference after three data fixes:
- **Time zone:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC (ending in `Z`). Only after converting it to Korea time (KST, +9 hours) did the quarter boundaries and Q2 values match. In UTC, Q2's top month came out as 2025-06 instead of 2025-05.
- **Customer identity:** there are 300 customer rows but only 250 distinct emails. Counting by row gave 270 customers for Q2 instead of 228, so I treat each email as one customer.
- **Segment values:** the same segment is spelled in different ways (e.g. `SMB`, `Enterprise `, ` consumer`). I trimmed spaces and lowercased them before grouping.
